answer: Identity imports can pass a taxed wharf: credibility carried in from other networks enters only through security bridges where every unit at the dock is scanned, its pulse of past activity verified against the origin ledger, and a burn fee is paid per unit of weight admitted. Legitimate agents cross with receipts of real history; a sybil army arriving from a cheap chain finds each fake stamped at the wharf as unproven wander stock, slowed to a trickle that cannot swing any quorum. Attackers pay by the ton; honest passengers pay once.
